newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, CHOOSE TO BAT VS NZ.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, CHOOSE TO BAT VS NZ.

text.p: Pakistan, two up in the three-match series, won the toss and chose to bat against New Zealand in the last one-day international in Karachi on Sunday.
Pakistan - Saeed Anwar, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmad, Inzamamul Haq, Muhammad Wasim, Moin Khan, Wasim Akram (captain), Shahid Afridi, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mushtaq Ahmad, Muhammad Zahid.
New Zealand- Bryan Young, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Mark Greatbatch, Chris Cairns, Nathan Astle, Justin Vaughan, Simon Doull, Chris Harris, Lee Germon (captain), Matthew Hart.
